maria: Heads up 99	Found a flaky onboarding repro in the Node sampleapp: when REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug the request-id seen in logs differs from the one attached to OTEL traces after a retry. Looks like an init-order race between the retry wrapper and telemetry autoinit.

maria: Minimal repro (local):
```
git clone github.com/redwood/sampleapp.git
cd examples/node
npm ci
REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug node server.js
# curl /chat with retries enabled
```
Observed behavior: incoming request shows rid A in server logs, retry wrapper assigns rid B, span.start stamps trace with rid A, then SDK init reconciles to rid B. Result: logs and traces disagree.

liam: can you paste the log snippet + deps and node version? we'll triage and propose a patch.

maria: snippet:
```
[2026-03-04T08:12:01.001Z] INFO  server  <-- incoming request { path: "/chat", request-id: "rid-A" }
[2026-03-04T08:12:01.004Z] DEBUG retry   retrying, assigning request-id: "rid-B"
[2026-03-04T08:12:01.005Z] DEBUG otel    span.start trace=trace-xyz request-id=rid-A
[2026-03-04T08:12:01.010Z] DEBUG sdk     init complete, reconciled request-id -> rid-B
```
Packages: redwood-telemetry@0.9.2, redwood-sdk@1.4.0, @opentelemetry/api@1.0.3, node v20.1.0

anjali: i've run into similar. The SDK takes a deferred init path when debug logging is enabled (we enable extra hooks). If middleware earlier stamps a header, the deferred path sometimes fails to copy that header into the reconciled context.

anjali: proposed fix: on telemetry.init(), detect existing req.headers['request-id'] or x-request-id and stash onto req._rw_orig_reqid before any reconcile. When creating spans prefer req._rw_orig_reqid if present. Add a unit test that simulates middleware stamping a header before init.

liam: +1. Also emit a telemetry.metric telemetry.requestid.reconciled with host tag so we can monitor frequency in hosted. Add changelog note: "preserve existing request-id across init paths (debug/info)".

maria: workaround i used: require('redwood-telemetry').init({forceSync:true}) at top of server.js and keep REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info when onboarding. That keeps ids consistent but loses richer debug captures for newcomers.

anjali: i'll open a small PR implementing the stash-and-prefer behavior, tests, and a changelog entry. assigning to @liam for review.

infra-bot: staging-deploy-bot scheduled redeploy of sampleapp-staging at 2026-03-04T11:00Z for verification.

maria: added issue #4522 with repro gist and assigned. i'll validate on staging once deployed. thanks :thumbsup:
